Name: Megumi Fushiguro NPC - Stardew Valley
Author: josiejjoestar
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds Megumi Fushiguro as an NPC. He is his own character and does not replace any other NPCs. WE all know he needs to enjoy some peace and quiet in the valley, so be nice to him and have fun![/color]

[b]Megumi Features:[/b]
Heart events (7 currently)
Festivals; he will be there at all of them, much to his chagrin! So look for him!
Ginger Island attire and dialogue (you are not ready for the fit)
Movie theater preferences and dialogue
Silly stuff he does with Yuji and Gojo mods (installation links below)
Reactions when you give him certain gifts (find out yourself, give him a hot pepper at your own risk)
He is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and works well with the other JJK mods!

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Install SMAPI:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
Install Content Patcher:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Download Megumi Fushiguro NPC - Stardew Valley here
Unzip the file and drag the folder into your "Mods" folder 

The link below will help you get started adding mods to Stardew if this is your first one! Feel free to comment with any questions.
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Modding Getting Started Wiki[/url]

I also recommend you install the Yuji Itadori and Satoru Gojo NPCs. Megumi will interact with them. He works fine without them, but some of his voice lines are about them so it's cooler if they're in the game with him!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21209]Satoru Gojo[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48565][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23955]Yuji[/url]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Pelliper Town Instructions[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelliper Town Mod[/url]

Look inside the 'README PELLIPER TOWN' folder in Megumi's mod

Take the file in this folder "villager_companions" and copy it.

Go into your Pelliper Town "PelliperTown.Mod" folder.
Click the assets folder
Click the data folder
Paste the "villager_companions" file in there.
It will overwrite the one that already exists.

Now, the JJK NPCs will have a Pokémon! [/color]

[b][size=4]Gift Preferences[/size][/b]
[b]Loves:[/b] Topaz, Rusty Cog*, Triple Shot Espresso, Midnight Carp*, Cloth, Duck Feather, Rabbit's Foot*, Star Shards, Obsidian, Amphibian Fossil, Fairy Rose*, Ginger*

[b]Likes:[/b] Rainbow Trout, Large Egg, Maki Roll, Rainbow Shell, Sea Urchin*, Puffer Fish*, Coffee, Purple Mushroom, Truffle, Wool, Pomegranate

[b]Dislikes:[/b] Glazed Yams, Rhubarb Pie, Cookie, Ice Cream, Blueberry Tart, Cranberry Sauce, Plum Pudding, Pumpkin Pie

[b]Hates:[/b] Hot Pepper, Mutant Carp

Items marked with a * cause Megumi to have a special dialogue about the gift

[size=4][b]Megumi's Schedule[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Megumi always starts at the Adventure Guild. (Home = Adventure Guild)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Monday: [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]7AM heads to the forest for training (underneath the big tree), moves to sit near the entrance to the secret woods at 4PM, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Tuesday: [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]7AM heads to town for training (underneath the big tree), moves to sit near the bench beside the community center at 6PM, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Wednesday:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]8AM heads to town to hang out with Yuji. Sits near the river, and then moves to the bench near Joja Mart at 4PM, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Thursday:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8] 7AM Heads to the forest for training, moves to sit near the lake at 4PM, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Friday:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  7AM Heads to the forest for training, moves to sit near the lake at 6PM, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Saturday:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8] 7AM heads to the Museum to help Yuji study, then moves to the Town at 4PM to hang out, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Sunday:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8] 7AM heads to the museum, then goes in to town at 6PM, then heads home at 10PM[/color]

[size=4][b]Heart Events[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]4 Heart Event: In Town any day between 1600 and 2200 (4PM and 10PM)
6 Heart Event: In the Cindersap Forest any day between 1800 and 2200 (6PM and 10PM)
6 Heart Event (2): In the Mines any day between 0600 and 1800 (6AM and 6PM)
8 Heart Event: In the Cindersap Forest (sunny day) between 1400 and 2000 (2PM and 8PM)
10 Heart Event: In Town any day between 1800 and 2200 (6PM and 10PM)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]12 Heart Event: Saloon any day on a sunny day between 1600 and 2200 (4PM and 10PM)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]14 Heart Event: Farm any sunny day between 1600 and 2200 (4PM and 10PM[/color]

Things to look for: weird numbers or symbols in dialogue, him disappearing, standing on top of other characters or in walls, making the wrong face for what he's saying etc.
